purpose: Resolve the user's proposed A/B/C fork after Candidate 1 commit 8fdd674, without assuming that closure fixes a state, curvature magnitude or thermality.

classical_channels.method: Independent fixed-integer-charge radial BVP at original couplings; domain and tolerance comparison

conformal_scope: Massless conformally coupled scalar, conformal vacuum in spatially flat FLRW; fixed midpoint proper times; H=1 at midpoint. Verify first-order shifted de Sitter kernel and an endpoint-anchored countercheck. This is not a full no-boundary path-integral construction.

slow_roll_test.tests: Residual after H_eff=H(1-epsilon) scales quadratically; unshifted comparison and endpoint anchoring retain linear terms. No infinite-time detector rate or minimally coupled IR state is claimed to have been recomputed.

curvature_test: Closed global de Sitter, a=cosh(H_Lambda t)/H_Lambda. Verify Omega_K=-1/(exp(2N)-1) at N=1,5,10,60; closed spatial sections coexist with arbitrarily small |Omega_K|. These are an exact limiting counterexample and inflationary dilution identity, not a fitted history of our universe.
topology: Exhibit a flat compact three-torus with periodic spatial coordinates. Compactness by itself does not fix spatial curvature sign. Additional action and boundary conditions may do so.
literature: Read primary Graham, Laflamme, Obadia, no-boundary and sequestering sources. Distinguish a previously published local-temperature coefficient from the stronger finite-separation/Wigner statement; absence of a search hit is not a novelty proof.
no_changes: No modification of Candidate 1, no new expensive one-loop integral, no assumption that any option is a universal theory.
